    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPostShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Shipping_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Parallel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsDepartmentHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersToSelect" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackageLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInsuranceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackageGoods" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNecessary" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuranceNecessary}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNotNecessary" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceJoinToReady" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToReady" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReady" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that one activity is always performed, while another activity is performed only under a stated condition, and both are followed by a shared later step (the activities may run together or separately depending on the condition): Model the unconditional activity and the conditional activity as outgoing branches of one inclusive split gateway placed where the description introduces them. Guard only the conditional branch with its condition, and leave the unconditional branch without a condition. Do not place a separate exclusive decision gateway in front of the conditional activity, and do not start the unconditional activity from a parallel split that also feeds the conditional branch. Rejoin the branches with one inclusive join gateway before the shared later step, so the flow continues when either the condition holds or fails. Do not use an exclusive gateway, which allows only one branch, or a parallel gateway, which forces the conditional branch to run.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity is always performed, while another activity is performed only under a stated condition, and both are followed by a shared later step (the activities may run together or separately depending on the condition)

rules.instruction: When the description states a data-based choice between alternative cases, where each case runs its own activities, and the flows of these alternative cases then continue into one shared later activity: After the activities of the alternative cases, place one exclusive merge gateway that receives the end of each alternative path, and connect that merge to the shared later activity. Do not connect the alternative paths directly to the shared activity, and do not let the shared activity follow only one of the branches.
rules.situation: the description states a data-based choice between alternative cases, where each case runs its own activities, and the flows of these alternative cases then continue into one shared later activity

rules.instruction: When the description states that a later activity is performed only if a readiness state holds, where that readiness is checked after one or more preparatory activities that run without any condition, and the description does not require those preparatory activities to be joined before the check: Model an exclusive gateway at the point where the readiness check occurs: after the preparatory activities and before the conditional activity. Give the outgoing flow to the conditional activity a condition that states the readiness requirement. Do not use a parallel gateway at this point, because it forces its branches to run and cannot express a condition. Place the gateway in the lane of the participant who checks readiness, or in the lane of the participant who performs the conditional activity if the description names no checker.
rules.situation: the description states that a later activity is performed only if a readiness state holds, where that readiness is checked after one or more preparatory activities that run without any condition, and the description does not require those preparatory activities to be joined before the check

rules.instruction: When the description states that, after a decision or condition, one outcome requires an extra activity before the process continues, while the other outcome skips that activity, and both outcomes then lead to the same later step: Model an exclusive gateway at the decision point with one outgoing flow to the extra activity under the condition where it applies and a second outgoing flow under the complementary condition that bypasses it. Connect the end of the extra activity and the bypass flow into one merging exclusive gateway, and connect that merge to the shared later step. Do not connect the extra activity directly to the shared later step, and do not omit the bypass branch.
rules.situation: the description has an exclusive decision whose two outcomes each start a different route, where one route is a multi-step route, and both routes then lead to the same later step

rules.instruction: When The description states an activity, decision or resulting state as a full clause with a subject, a modal or passive construction, or a leading condition or reason (for example 'the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the partner' or 'if everything is ready, ...'), and the generated element would copy that clause as its label.: Label the task or event as a short verb-object (or noun-phrase state) that names the activity and its business object, keeping any count or qualifier the description gives for that object, and drop the subject, modal and passive wording, purpose clauses and leading conditions. Put the condition itself only in the question label of a decision gateway, and name an end event by its resulting state in a few words.
rules.situation: The description states an activity, decision or resulting state as a full clause with a subject, a modal or passive construction, or a leading condition or reason (for example 'the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the partner' or 'if everything is ready, ...'), and the generated element would copy that clause as its label.

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant asks several outside companies to submit proposals or quotations and then chooses one of them, and does not describe those companies as having their own workflow or as exchanging messages with the process while the choice is made: Model the request to the candidate companies and the choice among them as activities in the requesting participant's lane. Do not create a separate pool for those companies, do not add message flows to or from them, and do not model the wait for their replies as a receive task. Place the selection activity in sequence after the request.
